references.text: The continuation of the instructions concerning the corner pillars, describing how they are to be connected from below up to the top with a ring.
A parallel text describing the actual execution of the tabernacle's corner pillars as made by Bezalel and the craftsmen.
The broader context for the tabernacle's pillars, providing background on the placement of the corner pillars at the back (west side) of the tabernacle.
A parallel account of the construction of the pillars for the sides of the tabernacle, including the back where the corner pillars were to be placed.
The candidate demonstrates the concrete execution of the structure (crossbars) necessary to realize the source's instruction regarding the planks on the back side.
